full_page.content:
1933, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 135 Cont.
Aug. 24 Lucile K of Fenton, Mich. - 14 - fallen kidney - Very sick . Blood pessure 240.
Nelson Yott - 36 - spinal - ? - of Chatham.
Harold Burkhardt - 38 - cancer - was big & stout, now very thin ...
Donald Fisher - 7 of Lansing - never spoke till enrolled June 14th last, now speaks a little.
Mrs. Law's wayward sister. .
Anna Cowen - 40 - sinus, rhumatism - has to support mentally in- valid sister & aged mother.
24 Gert. Cleary - of Rochester N. Y. phoned last night .... "on verge of nervous break-down", comes To-day (25th) 50% improved "- slept all night".
24th Lucile K. given up by specialist - enrolled at 9 P.M. To-night - 12:05 P.M. 25th "Improving" Last night bl'd pressure at 9 o'cl 280 - "no hope" -
Blank Page
Page 136 Page 137 Aug. 29th Sister M. Aquinas - Fel'n - offered herself as sacrifice to suffer whatever God might exact if only her father returned to Church and Sacraments. Father made Easter Communion ..... But Sister has T.B. However she was enrolled 2nd time a few weeks ago and now seems im- proving .... pray.
Sister M. Eligia - been teaching 8th Gr'd for many yrs. Had tonsils removed in vacation now feard T.B .. . . .
Donald Staub - 7 - like paralized - cannot bend legs or rise from from fall. Drs. say: "no possibility of cure."
H. Corby - 22 - broken appendix .. .improving - Mother fears other abcess forming.
Mr. Mary Gimaiel - 33 - 6 Children - tumor - fears operation.
Wm. Demery - 33 - fears stomach cancer has wife & 2 little children depending on him.
Klass Kroon - 28 - n. cath. - Wife & 2 -- lung trouble.
